summary.intent: Review a PR implementing an `entire attach` command for importing existing agent sessions into the Entire devenv tool, then address specific review findings.
summary.outcome: All actionable review points were resolved: a comment was updated to explain checkpoint/strategy coupling, error messaging was improved when auto-detection fails, depth calculation was made robust using filepath.Rel, and a UX bug where `entire attach` with no args showed a bare error instead of help text was fixed.

repo: root.go:39 sets SilenceUsage: true globally, which means ExactArgs validation errors never show usage/help — commands needing help-on-no-args must handle it in RunE with cmd.Help()
GetStrategy() already returns *strategy.ManualCommitStrategy directly — the interface/concrete coupling is global, not local to attach.go

CondenseSessionByID depends on 5 private methods on the strategy struct (loadSessionState, CondenseSession, clearSessionState, saveSessionState, cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused), making it non-trivially extractable
Checkpoint storage is conceptually strategy-independent but currently lives on the ManualCommitStrategy struct — noted as known debt
IsTrailerLine regex (^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*: ) is intentionally loose but is only called inside AppendCheckpointTrailer which requires blank-line-above context, preventing false positives in practice

code.finding: Guard blocks re-attaching already-tracked sessions entirely, but there's a valid use case: session tracked but commit never got the Entire-Checkpoint trailer
Fixed: when auto-detection fails, error now combines original agent error and auto-detection failure for clearer diagnostics
condenseAndFinalizeSession takes *strategy.ManualCommitStrategy directly — acceptable because GetStrategy() already returns this concrete type everywhere
Fixed: replaced strings.Count(filepath.Separator) depth arithmetic with filepath.Rel which handles trailing slashes and path normalization correctly
IsTrailerLine false positives (e.g. 'error: connection refused') are known and documented — safe because it's only used with blank-line-above guard

workflow: When SilenceUsage is set globally, use cmd.Help() in RunE for missing-arg cases rather than cobra.ExactArgs()
filepath.Rel is cleaner than counting path separators for depth calculations
When combining errors from a primary attempt and a fallback auto-detection, include both in the error message so users understand which path was tried

friction: Repeated re-reads of the same diff tool-result file (bag4ea9w2.txt read 4+ times) trying to find lifecycle.go and manual_commit_hooks.go sections — those diffs were apparently not fully accessible via that cached result
Several review points were initially overstated and had to be walked back during discussion (GPG signing concern, strategy coupling, trailer false positive)
open_items: attach.go:173: Re-attaching an already-tracked session to amend a commit with the Entire-Checkpoint trailer is currently blocked — need to decide if the path should be: (1) load existing checkpoint ID and skip straight to promptAmendCommit, or (2) force re-condensation
Checkpoint storage (CondenseSessionByID and related private methods) is conceptually strategy-independent but coupled to ManualCommitStrategy — deferred until a second strategy actually requires it
attach_test.go: TestAttach_CursorSuccess and TestAttach_FactoryAIDroidSuccess are nearly identical and could be table-driven — deferred as a nit
